conditions: There exists a folder named "Budget" in Box, uniquely identifiable by that name.
That folder has an owner — the Box user set in the folder's "owner" field (the owner collaborator role), not necessarily its creator.
Among all files, identify PDFs (file type/extension .pdf) whose modified_by is that owner.
Of those PDFs, select the one with the most recent modified_at timestamp — i.e., the PDF that owner most recently modified.
The tag "owner-edit" is added to that specific file.

readings: A folder whose name contains "Budget" as a recognizable label (e.g. "Budget 2025", "Budget Planning")

ambiguities.phrase: the owner of the Budget folder
readings: The user set as the folder's owner (Box's explicit owner field/role)
The user who originally created the folder

ambiguities.phrase: the PDF that the owner ... last modified
readings: Among PDF files, the one that owner most recently modified (filter to PDFs first, then take max timestamp)
The single most recently modified item by that owner overall, valid only if that item happens to be a PDF
